Park Ranger Rose asks Rubble and crew to fix the bridge to Bear Island; but when Speed Meister intervenes, the pups must clean up his mess and protect the bears from a rapidly approaching storm with help from Auntie Crane's new Bark Yard Zoomer!

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E24 — Pups Save a Jukebox; Pups Save a Mayor on a Wire
Mayor Humdinger steals a jukebox so he can play an annoying song all day long, but Chase and Rubble track it down to save the records; a hungry eagle causes Mayor Goodway's tightrope walking lesson to go awry, sending her down Jake's Mountain.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E01 — Pups Save the Kitty Rescue Crew; Pups Save an Ostrich
Mayor Humdinger creates fake emergencies for his kitties so they can appear better than the PAW Patrol; the Wingnuts get a new pet ostrich, but it gets lost on the trip home.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E02 — Pups Meet the Cat Pack
When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat Meow-Meow into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the PAW Patrol calls in the Cat Pack for help with stopping the creature.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E15 — Pups Save a Friend; Pups Save a Stowaway
When Marshall begins to feel like his clumsy ways are ruining his friends' fun, he decides to take a break from the PAW Patrol and goes off to the woods; Cali becomes an unsuspecting stowaway when she is accidentally packed up into the Paw Patroller.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E25 — Pups Take in a Runaway Kitty!; Pups Save the Cheese Goat!
When Rocky Kitty runs away and tries to join the "PAW Patrol," he helps the pups rescue Humdinger and the kitties from a hang-glider ride; when the Good Neighbor Robots confuse Farmer Al's request, they wind up being the target of a hungry eagle.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E09 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: When Super Kitties Attack
When the Kitty Catastrophe crew gets superpowers, the little kittens cause big problems all over town.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Peppa Goes to Paris; Grandpa Pig's Pond; Once Upon a Time; Super Potato; Playgroup Star
Peppa and family go on a trip to Paris to meet Delphine Donkey and her family; the Donkey family take Peppa and family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Daddy Pig to face his fear of heights.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Mountain Climbing; Trampolines; Skateboarding; Hoops; Soft Play
Grampy Rabbit teaches mountain climbing; Peppa goes to a trampoline park; Peppa and George play with their skateboards; Madame Gazelle and the class workout; Grandpa Pig takes Peppa sailing.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Families; Charity Shop; Hippies; Little Cars; The Perfect Day
The children draw pictures of their families; Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the Charity Shop; a long time ago, Granny and Grandpa were hippies; Peppa visits the Little Cars play centre; Peppa visits a big shop full of little shops.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Lots of Muddy Puddles; Buttercups, Daisies, and Dandelions; The Marble Run; Mr. Potato Comes to Town; Shake, Rattle, and Bang
Peppa looks for words to describe puddles; Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers; all the people in town are excited to meet Mr. Potato; Madame Gazelle brings lots of musical instruments.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E11 — The Kingdom of Sleepwell!
All is not well in the normally well-rested Kingdom of Sleepwell because Princess Deema can't fall asleep; her royal court comes to her aid, but even magic doesn't work.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E01 — The New Guppy!
The Sea Witch steals the Guppies' magical jewels so she can rule the Seven Seas; the Guppies must get their jewels back and stop her before it's too late.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E08 — Who's Gonna Play the Big Bad Wolf?
When an actor cannot perform at a play, Deema must take the stage.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E10 — Check It Out!
Gil and his friends dive into Gil's favorite books to find his missing library card.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E05 — Winter Sports Chompetition!
Gil and Bubble Puppy are competing in the Winter Sports Chompetition, a competition for athletes and their dogs; they hope to stop reigning champs Coldsnap and his dog Mr. Husky from cheating to win the gold.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E19 — Fogzilla!
It's lighthouse keeper Deema's birthday, but when a monster named Fogzilla keeps blowing out her lighthouse, she needs to figure out how to get Capt. Molly's ship, carrying her birthday cake to shore, or there won't be a party.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E19 — Bring on the Bugs!
The Guppies march with all different kinds of bugs in the Big Bug Parade.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E05 — Batterball!
Molly and Gil see how bubble-cakes are made when they step into Chef Stef's kitchen; the Guppies get their turn when they take the field to play batterbal; it'll take teamwork to run the kitchen-station bases and bake a treat!

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E12 — The Sizzling Scampinis!
The Bubble Brothers Circus is coming to town, and all the Guppies are getting into the act: Goby the clown, Gil the acrobat, and Oona the lion tamer.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E07 — Robo Puppy!
Robot Mechanic Molly and Robo Puppy must stop a bossy cyborg named the Glitch when it hacks all the robots in Robotopolis and forces them to dance "The Robot."

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E02 — Search and Rescue: Pups Save the Bike Race
In Adventure Bay, a major bike race is underway, and nearly the entire town is participating; with so many bikes on the roads, maintaining safety is a challenge; Chase and his team of Safety and Rescue Pups are on the job.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E04 — Pups Save a High Flying Skye; Pups Go for the Gold
When Corny runs away from Farmer Al's farm during a blackout, the pups need to light the way to get them home safely; uncle Otis hurls down Jake's Mountain in a runaway mine car.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E20 — The Crew Builds a Post Office; The Crew Builds a Farm Animal Wash
Builder Cove needs a post office but when construction gets squirrely, it's up to the pups to find a construction solution; using construction skills to convert the super car wash and clean Farmer Zoe's extra muddy animals.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S02 E13 — The Crew Builds a Reuse-It Station; The Crew Builds a Duck Bridge
When Speed Meister builds his own station for reusing trash, the pups have to clean up the mess all over Builder Cove; after a baby duckling follows them home, Rubble & Crew use their construction know-how to bring the duckling back to its home.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S07 E11 — Pups Save the Skydivers; Pups Save the Cupcakes
Mayor Goodway and farmer Al are ready for a day filled with skydiving fun; Alex and the Mini Patrol get locked inside the flounder.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E06 — Air Rescue: Pups Save the Airport Opening
Adventure Bay is getting a new airport! Sweetie tries to take the Princess' place at the grand opening.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E04 — Pups Save Helga and the Humsquatch; Pups Save the Missing Bone-Stone
While Humdinger gets dressed for a day with his Hummy Mummy, the Humsquatch accidentally puts on the mayor's suit and takes his place; when a precious bone goes missing, the Pups' only chance at getting it back is to team up with Sweetie.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E06 — Air Rescue: Pups Save the Mother Tree; Pups Save the Ice Cream Truck
Tracker and Lucita Buena call on the Air Rescue Pups to help save an irreplaceable Mother Tree; it's then up to the Paw Patrol to fix Mr. Porter's ice cream freezer before everything melts!

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E26 — The Crew Builds a Treehouse; The Crew Builds a Chicken Feeder
Park Ranger Rose's favorite old tree is off limits for fun climbing, unless Rubble and Grandpa can come up with a construction solution; Rubble and Crew are building a feeder for Farmer Zoe's chickens.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E25 — The Crew Builds a Parking Garage; The Crew Builds a Campsite
Café Carl's new ice cream machine brings lots of cars to Builder Cove; Rubble's fear of the dark derails the pup's Bark Yard campout.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E11 — Air Rescue: Pups vs. the Hum-Cloud; Air Rescue: Pups Stop the Mid-Air Magnet
Humdinger tries to sabotage the Air Rescue Pups' Air Show; Uncle Otis' powerful magnetic drone goes rogue and starts picking up every metal object in sight.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E22 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Frozen Flounder; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Narwhal
Cap'n Turbot's boat gets frozen in the Arctic ice; the pups use the Sea Patroller to help guide a lost narwhal back home.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E23 — Pups Save the Gliding Turbots; Pups Save a Plane
When Francois and Cap'n Turbot get stranded on a remote island, Ryder and the pups must fly in to rescue the bickering cousins; the pups must come to the rescue when Mayor Goodway's first flying lesson goes awry.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E15 — Pups vs. the Robo-Ducky; Pups Save the Lost Penguin
Digi and Tal build a big Robo-Ducky that runs amok through Adventure Bay; when Mayor Goodway tries to catch a glimpse of a migrating penguin colony, her precious Chickaletta and a Baby Penguin accidentally switch places.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Piggy in the Middle; Pancakes; Thunderstorm; Daddy's Movie; Bicycles
Peppa teases George; Mummy Pig makes pancakes; Peppa and George hear a strange noise; Daddy Pig gets a new movie camera; Peppa's friends ride their bicycles.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Rescuing Miss Rabbit!; Peppa's Diary; Playing Golf; Creepy Crawly Safari; Buried Treasure
Miss Rabbit needs rescuing; Peppa finds out Mummy Pig used to keep a diary; Peppa and George are being taught how to play golf; the playgroup visits a nature reserve; Peppa and her friends find a box of pirate treasure.

title: Peppa Pig
description: Peppa, an outgoing preschool pig, participates in many energetic activities; she learns something new every day and has a lot of fun with her family and friends.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Spring; Miss Rabbit's Helicopter; Baby Alexander; Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse; Miss Rabbit's Day Off
Grandpa Pig organizes an egg hunt; Miss Rabbit takes Peppa's family for a ride; Peppa's cousin visits; Grandpa Pig takes everyone to visit the lighthouse; Miss Rabbit hurts her ankle.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E05 — Pups Save an Extreme Lunch; Pups Save a Cat Burglar
Daring Danny X is harnessed over a canyon eating an extreme lunch when the wind blows him upside down; during Pie Swap Day in Adventure Bay, Humdinger sends Rocky Kitty to take one of Mr. Porter's pies so he can join the contest.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E21 — Pups Save a Cuckoo Clock; Pups Save Ms. Marjorie's House
Jake's family cuckoo clock slides down the mountainside with Chickaletta stuck inside; mysterious holes appear all over Ms. Marjorie's yard.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E06 — Pups Save Friendship Day
While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups must prevent Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E08 — Pups Save the Dizzy Dust Express; Pups Save the Treetop Trekkers
When the Dizzy Dust Express appears with no one aboard, the PAW Patrol must stop the runaway train and find the missing passengers; Ms. Marjorie, Tilly Turbot and Mayor Goodway get stranded in the treetops on their jungle zip-lining adventure.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E06 — Pups and the Stinky Bubble Trouble; Pups Save the Baby Ostriches
A strange odor chases jungle animals away from their homes; after Olivia the Ostrich falls into a canyon, the pups work together to lift her to safety and protect her soon-to-hatch eggs.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E10 — Pups Save the PawPaws; Pups Save a Popped Top
Carlos and Tracker make PawPaw juice with the PAW Patrol when they find out Mayor Goodway and Chickaletta are in trouble; Farmer Al needs help saving his corn crop after the top of his silo gets knocked off.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E03 — Pups Save a Melon Festival; Pups Save a Cow
Mayor Humdinger's plan to win the giant melon contest goes off the rails when his "melon" bounces away and causes chaos all over town; Farmer Al's truck gets stuck on a broken bridge.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E05 — Pups Save a Sleepover; Pups Save the Carnival
Farmer Al's animals go missing during a sleepover; Cornelius escapes from the pig ride at the carnival, and all the prizes have gone missing too.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E03 — Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: Rocket Rescuers; Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: The Golden Lion Mask
Cat-Pack members Wild and Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket; when the Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Shade and Wild must help the PAW Patrol to retrieve the stolen artifact.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E23 — Pups Save Luke Stars; Pups Save Chicken Day
When Luke Stars gets stuck on a ledge, Ryder and Marshall rush to the rescue; Mayor Goodway's big plans for Chicken Day become threatened when the Chicken of Honor, Chickaletta, mysteriously disappears.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S04 E03 — The Crew Builds a Fancy Drive-Thru Restaurant; The Crew Builds a Castle Show
When Camila the truck driver needs a place to stop and eat, the pups and Café Carl have a fancy idea; Park Ranger Rose and Rosie the goat are putting on a show; when Rosie disappears, can the pups find her before showtime?

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S03 E01 — The Crew Builds a Vet Clinic; The Crew Builds a Mermaid Party
When the traveling veterinarian Dr. Diwa can't finish all her checkups in Builder Cove in time, Rubble and crew know just what to do; Lily's mermaid-themed birthday party is called off when it starts to rain.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E09 — Pups Save a Dragon; Pups Save the Three Little Pigs
Marshall wakes from a nap to find a real, fire-breathing dragon guarding a sleeping Katie in the Lookout Tower; the pups build a house for three little piglets.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E09 — Pups Save a Sleepwalking Bear; Pups Save Dude Ranch Danny
The pups need to get a sleepwalking bear back home before he wakes up; Daring Danny X takes his horse off the trail and ends up on a wild ride.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E02 — Pups Save a Teeny Penguin; Pups Save the Cat Show
Everest and Jake try to rescue a little penguin and end up floating out to sea on a homemade bridge; Katie's kittens are all covered in mud and running amuck, so the pups must round them up before the Cat Show is ruined.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E05 — Air Pups
The Pups must come to the rescue when a family of monkeys scatters into the jungle after being scared off by lava erupting from a volcano.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E21 — Fire Rescue: Pups Save Lizzy's Lemonade Blaze
Mayor Humdinger and his kitties accidentally set Lizzy's Lemonade Stand and parts of Foggy Bottom ablaze; it's up to the pups to extinguish the fires.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E12 — Pups Save a Hum-nata; Pups Stop the Foggy Skies
Mayor Humdinger's birthday party goes horribly awry when Marshall Kitty gets trapped inside a life-sized piñata; Mayor Humdinger tries pushing fog into Adventure Bay, it's up to the PAW Patrol to find animals missing in the clouds and save the day.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Ballet Lesson; Grandpa Pig's Boat; Tidying Up; Picnic; Daddy Puts Up a Picture
Peppa is excited about her first ballet lesson; Granny and Grandpa Pig have a little boat; Peppa and George have to clean their bedroom; the family goes on a picnic; Mummy Pig has a new picture.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
The Cycle Ride; Dens; Zoe Zebra the Postman's Daughter; Cuckoo Clock; Ice Skating
Peppa's family goes for a cycle ride; Peppa and George play in their tree house; the postman's daughter helps him; the cuckoo clock is broken; Peppa and George go ice skating.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
The Children's Fete; Fruit; The Aquarium; The Fish Pond; Pedro Is Late
The children organize a party to raise money for a new roof; Miss Rabbit makes fruit smoothies; Peppa takes Goldie to the aquarium; Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to see a fishpond; Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit are stranded on a desert island.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Made Up Musical Instruments; Butterflies; The Botanical Gardens; Viking Day; Mr. Potato's Quiz
The children make instruments from old packaging; Doctor Hamster talks about butterflies; Peppa and George spend a day at the botanical gardens; Peppa and George pretend to be Vikings with Granny; Mr. Potato is a special guest at school.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E01 — X Marks the Spot
The Guppies help a friendly pirate search for treasure using a map.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E12 — Gup, Gup and Away!
The Bubble Guppies fly an airplane through the sky.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E17 — Happy Clam Day!
The Bubble Guppies have to learn about the mail so they can send invitations to a party for Clam.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E07 — Firefighter Gil to the Rescue!
Gil and his team of firefighters must rescue another firefighter who is stuck in a tree.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E17 — Bubble Scrubbies!
The Guppies perform a "soap opera" to teach Mr. Grouper about good hygiene.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E17 — It's a Lizard!
When showman Gil's real live dragon (actually a Komodo dragon) gets loose in the small town of Bubbleville, it's up to Pet Finders Oona and Zooli to track the lizard down and return it to its home on Komodo Island.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E02 — Secret Agent Nonny!
Secret Agent Nonny is on a mission to deliver mysterious messages to all of his agent friends, which are actually invitations to his own surprise birthday party.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E13 — The Summer Camp Games!
Molly, Gil and the Guppies celebrate summer with lots of outdoor fun; Gil uses his camping skills to rescue Bubble Puppy during the Summer Camp Games.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E10 — Fishketball!
The Guppies prepare for a game of fishketball by practicing bouncing, throwing, catching and playing together as a team.
